added_mass.cost_why: reads the cell's gas gradient that the point value already computes; a few operations
added_mass.summary: Half the displaced gas mass moves with the sphere (C_A = 1/2), with the gas's own acceleration

basset_history.cost_why: 29 history vectors per particle (62 values in 2D, 92 in 3D), summed every stage: several times the particles' work and memory; order 3/2 in the step
basset_history.summary: Basset history force of the slip's past in creeping flow, from 29 exponentials of the kernel

pressure_gradient.cost_why: reads the cell's pressure gradient that the point value already computes; a few operations
pressure_gradient.summary: Force of the gas pressure gradient over the sphere's volume, in place of plain buoyancy

saffman_lift.cost_why: reads the cell's velocity gradient already computed: a curl, a square root and a cross product
saffman_lift.summary: Saffman lift of a sphere slipping through a shear
